newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Impregilo returns to profit in H1.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Impregilo returns to profit in H1.

text.p: Italian construction group Impregilo SpA said group net profit was back in the black in the first half of 1996 after four years in the red.
It said consolidated net profit was one billion lire against a loss of 32 billion lire in the first six months of 1995 and loss of 14 billion at end-1995.
Operating profit rose to 35 billion lire from 24 billion lire at the end of June last year, the company announced at a news conference.
For the full year 1996, Impregilo forecast group turnover of 2.8 trillion lire, in line with 1995, with consolidated debt down on the 932 billion lire at end-June 1995.
